channel.title: 3ABN Today Bible Q&A
channel.desc: How are common, everyday sins forgiven, such as ornery feelings, grumpiness, and lack of faith? We'll explore how these human nature sins can be forgiven through confession, repentance, and God's grace. We'll also look at how recognizing and bringing our daily shortcomings before God can help us grow in faith and receive His forgiveness, no matter how small the sin may seem. Tune in for practical insight on living with humility and grace in our everyday walk with Christ.
